3.2 Building

make setup                                    # Python environment (uv)
make build-rust                               # Rust tools
cd ocaml-archive
opam exec --switch 5.4.0+ox -- \
  dune build --build-dir _build-5.4.0+ox bin/main.exe bin/dngc.exe

bin/dngc.exe is dngc, bin/main.exe is dng-archive. The same command with --switch default builds them with stock OCaml. The prerequisites (ExifTool, xdelta3, uv, Rust, opam) are in Part V, Install and build. The OCaml code uses Tursolite for its SQLite files, so the opam switch needs firstpair-tursolite pinned at the version in ocaml-archive/dng-archive.opam.
